features: Dual-Mode Connectivity (Bluetooth + 2.4GHz Wireless) Seamlessly switch between Bluetooth and 2.4GHz wireless mode for smooth multi-device connectivity. Perfect for laptops, PCs, tablets, and even smartphones
Foldable Mouse The mouse can be folded in half for comfortable travel, just snap to fold or open.
Adjustable DPI up to 3200 Customize cursor sensitivity up to 3200 DPI for precise tracking—ideal for work, browsing, design tasks, and casual gaming.
Type-C Rechargeable Battery Say goodbye to disposable batteries. The Type-C rechargeable design with auto sleep mode ensures long-lasting performance and energy efficiency.
Ergonomic & Lightweight Design Designed for comfort with a smooth grip and lightweight build, making it perfect for long work sessions without wrist strain.
Wide Compatibility Compatible with Windows, macOS, Android, and more. Works effortlessly with smartphones, laptops, tablets, and PCs.
description: Meet Toad Fold, the smart and portable wireless mouse designed for productivity on the go. Featuring dual-mode connectivity with both Bluetooth and 2.4GHz wireless, it lets you seamlessly switch between multiple devices, including laptops, PCs, tablets, and smartphones. Its innovative foldable design snaps open for ergonomic comfort and folds flat for effortless travel and storage. With adjustable DPI settings up to 3200, a Type-C rechargeable battery with power-saving auto sleep mode, and a lightweight, wrist-friendly build, Toad Fold delivers precision, convenience, and all-day comfort. Compatible with Windows, macOS, Android, and more, it's the perfect companion for work, study, and everyday use.
